topic: What trade-offs exist between array size and radiation efficiency for SIW arrays in high-gain inter-satellite antennas?
consensus_response: Increasing array size in SIW arrays leads to higher insertion loss due to longer SIW lengths, resulting in reduced radiation efficiency. This trade-off affects link performance, causing decreased signal-to-noise ratio and increased error rates. Optimizing SIW geometry and beamforming techniques can mitigate efficiency losses, but introduce complexity trade-offs.
reference_context: Experimental results show radiation efficiency drastically decreases with array size increase, affecting antenna gain and link performance.
